research_status: Independent FCFF reconstruction with capital/tax/calendar qualifications; independently audited
decision_es: Esperar precio o evidencia. Central65,80; sin entrada, calendario y reservas sin certificar.
decision_en: Wait for price or evidence. Central65.80; no entry, calendar and reserves not certified.
pros_es: La marca y la distribución se apoyan en once trimestres de crecimiento; Q2 mantiene margen bruto GAAP de 44,9%.
El EBIT TTM sin devolución arancelaria crece 18,17%, con SBC conservada como coste.
No hay préstamos dispuestos y el puente conserva más de 1.020 M$ tras reservas explícitas.
cons_es: El central FCFF de 65,80 no respalda el cierre de 92,85; el favorable de 98,90 no es un techo garantizado.
H1 CFO cae mientras inventarios consumen 65,242 M$; la mejora TTM no elimina riesgo de circulante.
El proveedor sigue bajo capacidad requerida y Q3 incluye 70–80 M$ de ventas afectadas; fiscalidad y próximo calendario conservan reservas.
pros_en: Brand and distribution support eleven quarters of growth; Q2 GAAP gross margin is 44.9%.
TTM EBIT excluding the tariff refund grew 18.17%, retaining SBC as an expense.
No borrowings are drawn, and the bridge retains more than $1,020m after explicit reserves.
cons_en: The $65.80 central FCFF case does not support the $92.85 close; the $98.90 favorable case is not a guaranteed ceiling.
First-half CFO declined as inventory consumed $65.242m; stronger TTM cash does not remove working-capital risk.
Supplier capacity remains below requirements and Q3 includes $70–80m of affected sales; tax and the next earnings date remain qualified.
publication_note: Preserve historical A108 FCFE41.54/76.60/120.42; no exact reproduction claim. Do not change portfolio/stop/lot. Do not invent scanner date or next earnings confirmation.
